sentences.en: Dreams of finding lost treasure almost came true recently.
sentences.zh: 最近，寻找失踪宝藏的梦想几乎变成了现实。

sentences.en: A new machine called 'The Revealer' has been invented
sentences.zh: 人们发明了一种叫“探宝器”的新机器，

sentences.en: and it has been used to detect gold which has been buried in the ground.
sentences.zh: 它被用来探测埋在地下的金子。

sentences.en: The machine was used in a cave near the seashore where --it is said--pirates used to hide gold.
sentences.zh: 这台机器被用在海边的一个山洞里——据说海盗过去常把金子藏在那里。

sentences.en: The pirates would often bury gold in the cave and then fail to collect it.
sentences.zh: 海盗们常把金子埋在洞里，然后又没能取走。

sentences.en: Armed with the new machine, a search party went into the cave hoping to find buried treasure.
sentences.zh: 一支配备了这种新机器的搜索队进了山洞，希望能找到埋藏的财宝。

sentences.en: The leader of the party was examining the soil near the entrance to the cave when the machine showed that there was gold under the ground.
sentences.zh: 队长正在检查洞口附近的泥土，这时机器显示地下有金子。

chunks.x: near the entrance to the cave

sentences.en: Very excited, the party dug a hole two feet deep.
sentences.zh: 大家非常激动，挖了一个两英尺深的洞。

sentences.en: They finally found a small gold coin which was almost worthless.
sentences.zh: 他们终于找到了一枚几乎一文不值的小金币。

sentences.en: The party then searched the whole cave thoroughly but did not find anything
sentences.zh: 搜索队随后把整个山洞彻底搜了一遍，除了
一个空的铁皮箱子什么也没找到。

sentences.zh: 尽管如此，许多人还是相信

sentences.en: 'The Revealer' may reveal something of value fairly soon.
sentences.zh: “探宝器”很快就会探测出有价值的东西。
